report: Promo code REGEN1MONTH rejected at Stripe Checkout with 'This promotion code is invalid.'
rootCause: The single allowed redemption was consumed on 2026-08-30 by 1936034135@qq.com (sub_1UA2wGGPXfP6Qy0mnqmElrDU, $19.99 / 100% off).
Stripe exhausts the coupon (times_redeemed == max_redemptions -> valid = false) and permanently inactivates the promotion code.
Stripe does not allow raising max_redemptions on an existing coupon, and promotion codes that reached their limit cannot be reactivated.
A second customer (renovace.elpetr@gmail.com) therefore receives 'This promotion code is invalid.'
adminConsoleDefect: The list view reads stripe_sync_status, which was last written before the redemption, so the exhausted code still renders as SYNCED.
The recordPromoCodeRedemption path only refreshes times_redeemed, never re-derives stripe_sync_status / is_active after a redemption.
The list shows 'Recorded redemptions' but never the redemption cap, so '1 of 1' is indistinguishable from '1 of 1000'.
Expires renders 'No expiration', which is accurate but unrelated to the redemption-cap failure.
Exhaustion is only detected by the on-demand Validate action; the list never surfaces it.
